mbm-2449.clue: The best cookie wasn't on my plate.
mbm-2449.quote: I entered the biscuit contest carrying one biscuit my little cousin had baked. I saved hers till the timer stopped. It had three chocolate chips in the shape of a face.

mbm-2450.clue: I do one last lift on the doorstep.
mbm-2450.quote: My neighbour leaves her empty shopping baskets beside my weights. When I finish my sets I carry those baskets home full of her groceries. She keeps adding potatoes.
